title: Reword the stale 'future work' boundary now the serialized publisher has landed
description:
src/epic-reconciler.ts's module header and src/env.d.ts's TICFAC_INTEGRATION doc both say integration waits on 'the serialized publisher (this phase's item 3) and the sandbox executor (item 4)'.

ef7 landed the publisher, so that recorded boundary is stale: integration now waits on the executor only.

ef7 deliberately did NOT edit these two sites, and its reasoning is worth preserving: the sentence cites a decision recorded by z23, and rewording someone else's recorded decision is a reviewer's call rather than an implementer's. That is the right instinct and the reason this is a tick and not a drive-by edit.

Work: reword both sites to say integration waits on the sandbox executor, and make clear that the publisher arrived in ef7 — the history should read as a boundary that moved, not one that was never there.

Found by ef7, run epic-ncv, finding 5863849f.
acceptance_criteria: Neither comment site names the serialized publisher as outstanding, and both attribute its arrival to ef7
